info.title: ApiToolKit - Display & Video 360 API
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Display & Video 360 API v4: every resource - partners, advertisers, campaigns, insertion orders, line items, ad groups, creatives, audiences, inventory sources, deals, channels, targeting options, users and more. Connect a Google account with GET /api/displayvideo/auth/url?accountKey=..., then pass the same accountKey to every endpoint.
